//: Copy to credential_map.json and edit. Routes specific subscriptions to specific Azure CLI accounts within ONE run, so a subscription that only one identity has sufficient RBAC on is never scanned (or silently skipped/overwritten) by the wrong account.
//_default: Account used for every subscription NOT listed in 'overrides' below. Must be a UPN already signed in via `az login` (run `az login` once per account -- each call adds to the CLI's signed-in account list, it does not replace the previous one).
//_overrides: Subscription ID -> account UPN, for subscriptions that need a DIFFERENT identity than the default (e.g. an '-adm' account with Contributor on a specific production subscription).
